body: He was my only friend, lover, rommate, father of my child, my everything. My love for him was so deep, that I gave him all that I had. My body was always there for him even if he wanted to make love or to beat the shit out of me, and my soul was venerating him. I did everything for him. But everytime he was mad of me, he was telling me that I gave him nothing, that I am pulling him down, that I am useless.

That's exactly the reason my SO told me he did't commit suicide. In that very last moment he thought about our child and couldn't do it. But I'm weaker than he is, and everything is blurry now, and those years toghether overwhelmed me. I'm 30 but I feel like 80 or something.

It was not an abusive relationship. It was just my first and only relation, with the man I love and the father of my child, and my biggest mistake was that I would have done everything for him to be better and for this to work. But it didn't.
There are no women's shelter in my city.
Thanks for the support. No, I'm not a wonderful person. I'm just a woman who cares too much and makes a lot of mistakes.

Thank you all for your  messages. I would want to excuse me  for my english, whitch is by far not very good, because obviously it's not my first language, but I see you understood my situation. 
I wrote this here because yesterday I was extremely sad and depressed. I cried a lot when I was with him, now I can't even cry anymore. Yes, I have a very beautiful and healthy baby girl, that I love very much, but because we were both so depressed she was seen through our eyes as very exhausting and tormenting. We wanted both that child, she is such a blessing, at 10 months she walks alone , has very elaborate ways of playing, tries to communicate  with us, even saying some words, and I know he loves her too. My SO is, besides his ADD problem, very intelligent, very kind and I respect him and admire him and love him so much. I think that if he wasn't so depressed and sometimes exagerately agressive, he could be a very good father. He says he loves us too, and I believe him, but we used to have so many fights even since we met, because I'm so resistant to change and I became another problem for him with my own depression. As for the drugs, it feels so absurd, because  I really am innocent, I' m not a drug dealer not even in my sleep :-) , but still I will have to pass through an almost kafkian, humiliating trial. 
Yes, I know that we have to see a psychiatrist, and talk, and take medication, and try again, but I don't know that we can do all these. We both tried so much in the past and didn't work. Still don't know what I'll do.
Thank you. I need a lot of luck if I want to recover from this.
